The '''Pelemax system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] creature known as the [[tentacle bird of Pelemax]] as well as the origin point of the [[Pelemaxian]] social group.<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pelemax [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
